subject: Prove one semantic coordination envelope is invariant across durable and low-latency carriers

body.text:
Separate coordination semantics from transport. The current run8-mesh Git branch is a durable sanitized async carrier. BonfyreMoQ provides a low-latency bounded ring relay for framed payloads; other local/native transports may exist. Do not make any carrier a semantic owner.

Define/reuse one canonical sanitized coordination envelope whose semantic identity/content digest is independent of carrier. For a LOCAL test only (do not open external network effects), send the same harmless event/ref payload through:
A) the existing run8-mesh file/Git representation, and
B) a bounded local relay/stream carrier such as BonfyreMoQ only if it can lawfully carry generic bytes without inventing a new owner.

On receive, canonicalization must recover the same event semantic identity/digest. Carrier observations remain separate: latency, bytes, retry/loss, ordering, timestamp, endpoint/placement. Durable Git ancestry and an ephemeral latest-value relay have different delivery semantics and must not be falsely equated. The canonical event must not inherit authority from either transport. Large artifacts should travel by content-addressed artifact refs rather than duplicating bytes in every message.

If MoQ is too media-specific in the current mature owner topology, keep it media-specific and prove carrier invariance with another existing local transport instead; do not distort a named Power just to satisfy the test.
